text:
alana: Morning folks — quick async: what I did: updated quickstart for Node ESM to include streaming example; blockers: samplekit packaging fails on mac M1 CI; today: finish packaging fix and small doc tweak on API examples. /cc @jess for packaging help

kevin: Thanks — can you drop the PR link? want to skim the streaming example. :eyes:

alana: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — added `streaming` snippet and note about `max_tokens`. small snippet: ```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'open-lite', input: 'hi' })
for await (const chunk of stream) { console.log(chunk.text) }
```

jess: @alana grabbing packaging now — I think the build matrix needs a wheel build for macos/arm. Will try a hotfix branch.

mira: I'm blocked on running the sampleapp locally — get runtime error when starting: ```
Error: cannot load shared object file: libm.so.6: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
    at start (/src/server/index.js:42:11)
``` Anyone seen this on WSL?

jess: Mira — that looks like a base image mismatch. Which dockerfile are you using? maybe try `FROM python:3.10-slim-bullseye` instead of alpine.

mira: Using the `samplekit/dev-env:latest` image. Will switch to bullseye and report back.

doc-bot: Lint report: docs/quickstarts/node-esm.md — 2 warnings (heading-level, missing code fence language). See CI artifact: https://ci.redwood/1234

kevin: Minor: in the streaming example can we add a `try/catch` example for network errors? otherwise lgtm.

alana: good call @kevin — adding `try { ... } catch (e) { console.warn('stream failed', e) }` — will push in PR.

jess: Packaging hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/88 — includes mac wheel + updated github actions. ping @mira for validation.

mira: validating now — started local run, no libm error so far. will post final green in ~10m.

alana: thanks all. blockers resolved? if mira green, I'll merge doc PR and cut a small release for quickstart. otherwise nothing else for me today.
